cmd_tiles.text: The majors are bigger and more global than the mid-size six, but their typical ROCE (about 18%) is close to the Nifty Pharma average. Inventory is the shared weak spot: four of six hold over 280 days.
cmd_tiles.angle: Working capital is the quickest cash win across the group.

cmd_map.text: Top right: Zydus (fast growth, high margin, partly bought) and Lupin (turnaround). Lower half on margin: Cipla and Dr Reddy's, both hit by the end of US lenalidomide, and Aurobindo (low-margin volume generics). Sun sits in the middle with the most scale.
cmd_map.angle: Cipla, Dr Reddy's and Aurobindo are the clearest consulting targets.

rt_table.text: Green and red mark the best and weakest of the six. A company can be best of six and still below the industry.

rt_trend_roce.text: Lupin rose from a loss to 30%. Dr Reddy's fell from 27% to 13% and Cipla from 23% to 15% as US lenalidomide ended. Aurobindo stays at about 13%.
rt_trend_roce.angle: Dr Reddy's, Cipla and Aurobindo need a returns plan.

rt_trend_roe.text: ROE follows ROCE; debt is low across the set.

rt_trend_roic.text: ROIC is the after-tax return on money put into the business. Above about 12% a company creates value. Aurobindo (about 8%) and Dr Reddy's (about 9%) are below it.
rt_trend_roic.angle: Below-12% companies need a returns plan before chasing growth.

rt_trend_ebitda_margin.text: Margins diverged in FY26: Zydus, Lupin and Sun near 28 to 31%; Dr Reddy's, Cipla and Aurobindo near 19 to 21%.
rt_trend_ebitda_margin.angle: The gap is mostly product mix: limited-competition and branded products earn more.

rt_trend_inventory_days.text: Sun (363 days) and Aurobindo (326 days) hold the most stock; all six hold more than 220 days.
rt_trend_inventory_days.angle: Each 30 days of stock cut frees cash worth about 8% of yearly material cost.

rt_trend_debtor_days.text: Dr Reddy's (110 days) and Sun (97 days) wait longest to be paid; Cipla (73) and Zydus (73) the least.
rt_trend_debtor_days.angle: Dr Reddy's is the clearest collections case.

rt_trend_ccc.text: Cash cycle = stock days + customer days − supplier days. Lupin's 181 days is the best; Aurobindo and Dr Reddy's (about 250) the worst.
rt_trend_ccc.angle: Aurobindo and Dr Reddy's have the most cash locked up.

rt_trend_de_ratio.text: Debt is low except Zydus, which rose to 0.5 after acquisitions. Sun will add large debt for Organon.

rt_trend_cfo_pat.text: Below 1 means profit is not arriving as cash. Zydus fell to 0.4 in FY26 (acquisitions and working capital).
rt_trend_cfo_pat.angle: Zydus needs a cash conversion review.

rt_trend_asset_turnover.text: Sales per rupee of assets is low (0.5 to 0.7) for all six: big plant networks and cash piles.

rt_trend_interest_cover.text: Interest is small for all; Zydus's cover fell after deals.

rt_trend_fcf_margin.text: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus all investing (plants, deals). Zydus (−21%) and Dr Reddy's were negative in FY26.

rt_dupont.text: ROE = profit margin × sales per rupee of assets × borrowing. Lupin wins on margin; Aurobindo is held back by low margin; Sun by idle cash.
rt_dupont.angle: Shows which lever to pull: price and cost, asset use, or funding.

rg_fda.text: Four of six have an open US FDA issue: Sun (Halol), Cipla (Pithampur), Lupin (Pithampur Unit II) and Aurobindo (Eugia Unit-I).
rg_fda.angle: Quality remediation is a group-wide consulting theme for the majors.

rg_anda.text: More approvals do not mean more profit: Aurobindo has the biggest US book (737 approvals) but the lowest returns; Lupin earns more from fewer, harder products.
rg_anda.angle: Product selection is worth more than filing volume.

rg_rnd.text: Higher R&D does not guarantee higher margin today: Zydus and Lupin show the payoff, Dr Reddy's shows the gap when a big product ends first.
rg_rnd.angle: Ask for the payback on each R&D bet.

nw_timeline.text: Results misses (Dr Reddy's, Cipla) and FDA actions moved these stocks most in the last six months.

nw_heat.text: US revenue and EBITDA margin are the numbers most affected by news.

st_map.text: Each number counts how many of a company's five problems need that type of consulting help.

pl_scatter.text: Each dot is one company in one year, so the pattern uses 30 points instead of 5.

market.text: The Indian pharma market grew about 10% in FY26, with chronic therapies ahead of acute.
